items.q: And then another time we'd rotated and the band was under Harry Carney's name.

ctx.x: The band was under my name, you know. So we did -- we came up with some very good things. And then another time we'd rotated and the band was under Harry Carney's name.
Oh, yeah. Oh, yeah, I think I have some of those 78s.
